name: baptism

phase_0.boundary_condition: The Trinitarian formula and the ecclesial body which contains the sacramental act.

VINIT.justification: The uninitiated subject exists in a state of spiritual void prior to the naming and the water rite.

TANCH.justification: The mystical body acts as the terminal container that holds the newly incorporated member.

AFWD.justification: The forward motion into the water represents the descent into death with Christ.

AREV.justification: The upward motion out of the water represents the resurrection and ascent into new life.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of the physical matter with the spoken word to produce the sacrament.

IMSCRIB.justification: The spiritual mark that identifies the soul as itself in its new ontological status.

FSPLIT.justification: The moment of immersion where the old man and the new man are distinguished as separate paths.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the individual where the old nature is washed and the new nature is assumed.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative result of the rite where the debt of original sin is cleared.

EVALF.justification: The negative branch representing the death of the carnal nature.

ENGAGR.justification: The state of being simultaneously justified and yet still subject to concupiscence.

IFIX.justification: The permanent, irreversible entry into the book of life and the parish register.

phase_3.void_description: The state of the unbaptized soul, lacking sanctifying grace and ecclesial identity.
phase_3.true_description: The state of grace and incorporation into the divine life.
phase_3.false_description: The state of spiritual death or the rejection of the sacramental offer.
phase_3.both_description: The liminal state of the initiate during the rite, existing between death and resurrection.

steps.domain_action: The catechumen stands at the threshold of the baptistery.
The candidate is named and identified for the rite.
The priest joins the intention of the Church with the physical presence of the candidate.
The candidate enters the water, initiating the separation of states.
The candidate is lowered into the water, signifying burial.
The water cleanses the soul, affirming the remission of sin.
The old nature is symbolically drowned and put to death.
The candidate is raised from the water, signifying resurrection.
The initiate holds the tension of being a new creature while remaining in the world.
The person emerges as a unified, regenerated being.
The soul recognizes its new identity in Christ.
The indelible spiritual character is fixed upon the soul.
The event is recorded in the temporal register of the Church.
The new member is sealed within the communal boundary of the faithful.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Officiant who executes the ritual according to the prescribed rubrics.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: The Trinitarian invocation which communicates the divine intent to the material element.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: The Tradition and the Liturgical Books which preserve the form of the rite.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Liturgical Calendar or the moment of conversion that dictates the timing of initiation.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Great Commission (Matthew 28:19) which serves as the bootstrap command for the domain.

phase_6.cycle_cost: The physical water and the breath of the spoken word.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: A fragmented individual burdened by original sin.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: A unified member of the mystical body in a state of grace.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The ritual is a conservative phase transition where the spiritual energy is reorganized into a higher order without loss of essence.
